content:
The 9to5Mac Overtime team discusses Apple's rumored screenless fitness band and explores why the product is so appealing. Fernando also shares his hands-on experience with the iPhone 18 Pro, the new Apple Watch Series 12, and Apple Watch Ultra 4. Plus, they report on some disappointing news about SSD upgradeability on the M6 Mac mini.

The 9to5Mac Overtime is a weekly video-first podcast exploring interesting observations throughout the Apple ecosystem, hosted by 9to5Mac's Fernando Silva and Jeff Benjamin. For more episodes, subscribe to Overtime on Apple Podcasts and our YouTube channel.
